description: Ministry of Labour - Order to authorize the Commissioner of Labour to determine a general minimum time rates for workers in the Beedi Manufacturing Trade and Cigar Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order made under the Wages Boards Ordinance, which represents a regulatory matter. It involves the exercise of statutory powers (Section 33(1)(a)) to authorize the Commissioner of Labour to determine minimum wage rates for specific trades. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
